description: Use when you need currency exchange rates, fx rates or forex conversion of an amount between two currencies like EUR and GBP. Do not use for live trading quotes, intraday or crypto rates (ECB rates update once per business day). Returns JSON with currency exchange rates: official ECB euro reference FX rates (free at ecb.europa.eu) for about 30 currencies, rebased to any base as cross rates, with optional conversion for 0.005 USDC per call. Typical response time 1500 ms (p95). Category: Data.

amount.description: Amount in the base currency to convert, e.g. 100

base.description: Base currency, ISO 4217 (EUR when omitted), e.g. USD

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

symbols.description: Currencies to return, e.g. ["BRL", "JPY"] (all ECB currencies when omitted)

name: blackwood_fx_rates

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: Currency exchange rates
